svg.text: Greenwood scaffold — top-down, north up, 1 px ≈ 0.9 studs. Planned layout (plan 12), not yet built.
grass-free walk links every place, both ways
Route A: out through the neck, past Pip, along the meadow, up the stairs to the terrace past Wren to the old fence; home by hopping the ledge into the ledge lane.
Route B: the river bank, a ramp and switchback up to the ridge, the old wood (with the spur to the Hollow), then steps down past Corwin to the gate.
